newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bolsas halt trade in Banco do Brasil today.
newsitem.headline: Bolsas halt trade in Banco do Brasil today.

text.p: Brazilian stock exchanges said they would suspend today trade in Banco do Brasil shares following a request by the bank which will release 1996 full-year results this afternoon.
"It is a normal procedure as we will release the results for 1996," said a bank spokesman.

Banco do Brasil officials will hold a news conference at 1500 local/1800 GMT in Brasilia. In the first half of 1996, the bank showed a 7.7 billion real loss, but between July and November the profits totalled 184.7 million reais.
